text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I hope Urara made it to training on time...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I woke her up before I left, but what if
she fell
asleep aga—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, no, stop that. A first-rate
Umamusume like
me shouldn't be
worrying about that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Starting tomorrow, she'll have to wake
herself
up.
